steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Why the long face, Chief? Still haven't found your target yet? I've also been looking for her for a long, long time.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Why don't you also come and ask the head nurse to hand her over? Then everyone will be happy.
Ted's gun is aimed at Anne. This scene brings back chilling memories. You remember how he tortured Brand, but this time, his bullets are on Anne's body.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Even with the healing power, you won't last much longer if you don't have enough strength. Hurry up and tell us.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She just needs to hold out until we finish you off, you bastard!
Hella holds up her weapon and strides forward to start fighting, but then sharp black crystal spikes suddenly stab out of the ground, forming a shield for Ted.
Once again, the gray-haired girl appears with a pale and emotionless face. What's oozing out from her wounds is no longer blood, but some dark crimson residue.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?! Dumbass! Do you know how many people you've harmed? He doesn't even see you as a human! Why would you help such a jerk?!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Heheh... That's because she's my dog. She will listen to my orders even if she's crippled.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I'm going to look for the suspect. You stay here. Don't let anyone get in my way.
Ted turns and leaves. After receiving her final order, the young girl remains silent for a while before she straightens up.
The pollutant on the floor starts to wriggle and squirm up the corpses, forming one after another filthy monster.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We must deal with her before we can catch up with Ted.
On the ground, Anne looks at you painfully. She speaks in a soft voice, but you understand what she wants to say:
